title: CmdPal: Port UI tests to UITestAutomation.Next (winappcli)

review.body_prefix:
Reassessed the current revision after it returned from draft. The four-file change extracts indexed-fixture cleanup, removes read-only attributes only from the known fixtures, deletes the known child without recursively removing unexpected folder content, and adds focused regression tests. An unexpected sibling inside the fixture folder deliberately raises an I/O error instead of deleting unrelated content; the tests check that it remains intact.

The exact current shared-framework test project builds with analyzers enabled. All 12 selected ModulePaths, SessionHelper and indexed-fixture cleanup tests pass, including preservation of the parent/sibling and refusal to delete unexpected folder contents. No required correction is requested for this examined delta.

The prior process-targeting assessment remains scoped: CommandPaletteSession uses Session.FromProcess, so same-process Settings searches are not restricted to the palette's main HWND. The saved follow-up review comments were assessed on their original revisions; this summary does not reinterpret them as a new clean result. Existing native window/process helper behavior does not justify a speculative broad catch.

This is a qualified assessment, not unconditional approval of the whole new UI suite. Packaged activation, signing, SamplePagesExtension deployment, live desktop workflows and the author's VM matrix were not independently executed on this revision.
